summary: Frontend-only verification of the German Reading Helper DEMO build (/grh-demo/index.html + settings.html) which renders the real Panel/Options components with mocked chat/TTS. All 9 requested feature areas PASS (~60 Playwright assertions). Demo build is up to date with src (no newer src files than build), yarn test 26/26 pass, tsc --noEmit clean. Two initial 'failures' were test artifacts: (a) 'Beispiele' label is CSS-uppercased so inner_text returns 'BEISPIELE'; (b) paragraph variant at 1920x1080 fits without overflow (content ~700px) — at 1366x700, 768x1024 and 390x844 panel-body is scrollable (scrollHeight 988-1100 > clientHeight 645-969) and the chat input is reachable via scrolling. Real OpenAI chat/TTS/lookup and the MV3 context menu were NOT executed (code review only).

ui_bugs.issue: ttsError is only cleared inside the `if (!card.audio)` branch. If playback was blocked/errored once with cached audio, clicking 🔊 again plays successfully but the stale error text (tts-error) remains visible.

integration_issues.flow: Chat / TTS / Lookup message passing (real extension)
integration_issues.issue: chrome.runtime.sendMessage calls in sendChat(), speak() and run() are not wrapped in try/catch. If it rejects (e.g. 'Extension context invalidated' after the extension updates/reloads while a tab is open), chatStatus stays 'loading' forever (input disabled, typing indicator spinning), ttsStatus stays 'loading' (speak button disabled spinner), or the card stays on 'Translating & explaining…'.

issues: User chat bubble uses a light-purple accent with white text in dark theme — contrast is borderline; consider a darker accent for .grh-msg-user in dark theme.

action_items: Wrap chrome.runtime.sendMessage in try/catch in content-main sendChat/speak/run and reset chatStatus/ttsStatus/status with an error message on rejection.
In speak(), clear card.ttsError (and reset ttsStatus) before every playback attempt, not just when fetching new audio.
Optional: content-main run() line ~320 falls back to ERROR_COPY.NO_API_KEY when no text is found and no fallbackReason — misleading message; use a 'no text selected' message instead.
Optional: storage.setCache never prunes expired entries (CACHE_TTL 7 days) — chrome.storage.local has a ~10MB quota without unlimitedStorage; prune expired/oldest on write.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy settings with Chinese:true are safely ignored because enabledLanguages() filters by ALL_LANGUAGES — good.
normalizeEntry slices examples to 3 but does not enforce exactly 3 (model may return fewer) — acceptable, UI handles 0..3.
Chat history sent to the model is unbounded per card; consider capping last N turns to control token cost.
TTS input silently truncated to TTS_MAX_CHARS for long paragraphs — consider telling the user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo URL: $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/grh-demo/index.html (?v=word|text|paragraph|loading|error|dark|compact) and /grh-demo/settings.html. Panel lives in open shadow root; Playwright locators pierce it. Use getComputedStyle-insensitive text checks (labels are CSS-uppercased). Verify scrolling at viewport height <=800 for ?v=paragraph. Screenshots taken immediately after load capture the grh-in fade animation (cards look faded) — wait ~500ms. Real OpenAI flows untestable headlessly.
